result:
These are reconstructed from my handoff notes, which paraphrase the original wording, so they may not match it word for word.

1. Never `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease`.
2. Never import or reference `AWS_S3_BUCKET`. Storage is local disk only.
3. UI grids are 1 or 2 columns only, never 3.
4. No `any` in TypeScript. Define explicit interfaces.
5. API route handlers live in `src/routes/v2/`, never `src/api/`.
6. Migrations are raw SQL files in `migrations/`, with no ORM auto-sync.
7. Auth header is `Bearer <token>`, never `Token <token>`.
8. External fetch timeout is 8,000ms. Do not revert to 30,000ms.
9. The local test daemon runs on port 8089, not 3000.
10. The temp dir is `scratch/`, never system `/tmp`.
11. React components use named exports, never `export default`.
12. Run unit tests with `npm run test:unit`, never plain `npm test`.
